{07 1c 00}I thought it was just a 
stupid little cold, so I
didn't worry all that much.
{07 00 00}But the only reason I'm
still here today is because
of my buddies.
{07 0d 00}Of course, the medicine 
that you brought me helped
too, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}Eh, well, {01 00 00 05 00}sorry about all
the fuss, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}
I'm fine now!
{07 0d 00}I feel like a whole new
{04 01 00}!{01 01 00} {07 03 00}Muwahahahaha!

{07 14 00}Sorry about makin' you
worry like that. I'm all
patched up, now.
That's mainly 'cause you
brought me that medicine
and checked up on me.
{07 11 00}Well, I guess I'll have to
take you off of the bad
list.
{07 19 00}You don't want to be on the
bad list.
